mapper.select: SELECT id, todo, detail, created_at, updated_at, author_id FROM todos ORDER BY created_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todos (todo, detail, created_at, updated_at, author_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{detail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updatedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{authorId,jdbcType=INTEGER})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM todos WHERE id = #{id} AND author_id = #{authorId}
